content: The American Diabetes Association recommends that men with diabetes who exhibit symptoms indicative of hypogonadism, such as diminished sexual desire or erectile dysfunction, should undergo screening for low testosterone levels. This screening should involve measuring serum testosterone levels in the morning, as this is when testosterone levels are typically at their peak. Research indicates that men with diabetes tend to have lower testosterone levels compared to non-diabetic men of the same age group. However, it is important to note that obesity serves as a significant confounding variable in this relationship, potentially influencing testosterone levels independently.
